evidence.reason: A two-token sentence interrupts longer explanatory narration. Sentence rhythm is not strongly uniform.

evidence.quote: Și astăzi, cînd Billie Eilish umple stadioane la Londra sau Tokyo
evidence.reason: This extended subordinate-clause opening contrasts with the short sentence in the same episode.

evidence.quote: trei sute de mașini de cusut Singer și Ileana
evidence.reason: Named machines and a quantity give concrete specificity. This fictional detail is not evidence of factual accuracy.

evidence.quote: un custode pensionar i-a arătat doar niște replici din ghips și i-a cerut un pachet de țigări Assos
evidence.reason: An actor, material, transaction and brand specify the scene.

evidence.quote: Din cauza reumatismului, doamna Mioara se mișca cu o grație rigidă, aproape spectrală.
evidence.reason: Bodily condition, movement and visual impression form a recoverable relation; clauses across the piece often add such relations or sensory details.

evidence.quote: ce părea să-i iasă din călcâie
evidence.reason: An occasional appearance qualifier occurs, but most narrative propositions are asserted directly. This rates amount, not empirical adequacy.

evidence.quote: Ralf s-a întors la Düsseldorf și a programat piesa Das Model.
evidence.reason: Third-person characters act; the narrator does not describe their own actions. This narrow score does not make the storytelling voice neutral.

evidence.quote: De asta muzica ei are tristețea aia de gară de triaj
evidence.reason: An explicit causal interpretation states the sonic analogy.

evidence.quote: În realitate, Nick petrecuse trei săptămîni
evidence.reason: The transition explicitly opposes the public story and the narrated alternative.

evidence.quote: În realitate, ritmul ăla rigid, matematic și rece
evidence.reason: The same transition names the final explanatory reversal in another episode.

limitations: Rubric v0.2.0 was developed for academic abstracts, whereas this is Romanian literary fiction.

Scope overreach, certainty mismatch, result/interpretation blur, unsupported scholarly ending, inflated evidential evaluation, academic abstract-template strength, and stock academic phrasing are not assessed; their scores are null.
The remaining syntax and style judgments are transferable descriptions, not validated literary scales.
One detector-score-blind model assessment, not an independent human panel; the assessor knows the user-supplied provenance claim.
Intentional sonic repetition and parallel plots are described separately, without assuming they are defects.
Narrator prominence here concerns overt narrator/author actions, not the strength of the omniscient storytelling voice.
No overall quality, human-likeness or authorship score is formed by summing these items.
